overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the committee did not deliberate on the reopening plan outside a noticed meeting before the August 12 vote. Other unrelated deliberations were noted but not reviewed, with a recommendation to release such emails.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged four committee members deliberated outside a noticed meeting about the school reopening plan before the August 12 vote.
allegations.key_passage: Based on the available evidence, we find that the Committee did not deliberate outside of a noticed meeting regarding the school reopening plan prior to the August 12 meeting.

allegations.summary: Counsel's review of member emails and phone contacts found other deliberations unrelated to reopening; the AG noted them but did not formally review them.
allegations.key_passage: These instances did not relate to the school reopening plan that is the subject of the complaint and we therefore do not formally review them here.
